captions.linkedin:
Most "ATS score" tools give you a number out of 100. Real ATSs don't score you; Workday, Greenhouse, Lever and Naukri's RMS read your file into text and fields, and recruiters search that.

So our free ATS checker shows what actually matters: the exact text an ATS gets from your file, plus checks for columns, tables, contact details, headings and dates, and which of a job's keywords you have.

Free, no sign-up: https://quickfitcv.com/ats-checker

#ats #jobsearch #resume #recruiting
